idea-plugin.name: Project View Bottom Files
idea-plugin.description:
A high-performance IntelliJ Platform plugin that organizes Java elements in the Project Tool Window by their type (Interfaces, Abstract Classes, Classes, Final Classes, Records, Enums, Annotations) while strictly keeping designated files (such as package-info.java) at the very bottom.

  • Folders Always on Top: Directories remain unaffected and stay at the top.
  • Type-Based Grouping: Interfaces, Classes, Enums, Records, etc. are grouped together according to their IntelliJ icon.
  • Alphabetical Ordering: All files within each group remain strictly sorted A-Z.
  • Bottom Files: package-info.java is always positioned at the very bottom.
  • Zero UI Latency: Stub-backed checks and dumb-mode resilience prevent any UI lag.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 - Initial release with high-performance TreeStructureProvider and BottomPsiFileNode.
